message: Hi! I want to try fitness classes for myself. How do I start?
Hey! That's awesome. I'm Emma from the studio. We'd love to have you try a class! Your first one is totally free, no commitment. What's your name?
Hi Emma! I'm Tester Opal. I'm excited to try a class!
Nice to meet you, Tester! So this is just for you, right? One adult trying out a class?
Yes, that's correct! Just me trying out a class.
Perfect! I just need a couple quick details to get you set up. What's the best email for you?
Got it! And what's your phone number? Just so we can reach you if anything comes up with your class.
Perfect! Last thing - what's your date of birth? Helps us keep our records straight.

Awesome! All set. Let me show you some times for your free trial class. How about one of these:

Tuesday 7/8 at 6:00 AM
Wednesday 7/9 at 8:30 AM
Wednesday 7/9 at 5:30 PM

Which works best for you?
I'll take the Tuesday 7/8 at 6:00 AM. Thanks!
Perfect! You're all booked for Wednesday 7/8 at 6:00 AM. We're at 6 W Parker Ave, Maplewood. Just wear comfortable workout clothes and bring water. See you then!
